I'm noticing the chat flow has no tools configured, so it can't actually look up order details—it would just hallucinate an answer rather than throwing an error. That makes me suspect the real issue might be elsewhere, perhaps in how the triage agent is configured with its turn limits and agent routing.

Actually, since "hello" works but order questions fail with an actual error, this points more specifically to the delegation mechanism itself—if maxTurns is set too low, the triage agent could hit that limit exactly when it needs to make a tool call to hand off to the order agent, which only happens for order-related questions. I want to check the agents middleware code to confirm how maxTurns interacts with delegation calls.

The `chat` flow has no tools, so it wouldn't produce an error on order questions. The likely path is `triage` (`maxTurns: 0`), which delegates to `orderAgent`. I'll check how the middleware treats `maxTurns` and delegation.

The runtime enforces `rawRequest.maxTurns ?? 5`, so `maxTurns: 0` makes any tool call throw. I'll confirm the agent passes `maxTurns` through to `generate` and that the `triage` config is the only zero value.

text:
I've traced the chain: prompt-based agents forward maxTurns through prompt.js line 112 to generate, which throws when tool requests exceed that limit. I'm now weighing whether to verify this empirically, but running the app would need an API key and a model call, and CLAUDE.md advises against running genkit commands directly.

The actual fix is clear: `maxTurns: 0` is the bug, and it needs to be a positive number. Since triage needs at least one turn to delegate and another to produce the final answer, and maxDelegations allows up to 3, I'll set maxTurns to 4 to match orderAgent's convention and give enough headroom for the full delegation-then-answer cycle. I'll double-check prompt.js:112 to confirm the forwarding logic before making the edit.
The agent is prompt-based, so `maxTurns` flows through the prompt config. I'll confirm the forwarding line in `prompt.js`.

The root cause is in `src/agents.ts`: the `triage` agent was set to `maxTurns: 0`. I changed it to `maxTurns: 4` and wrote `answer.json` in the project root.

Genkit's tool loop throws `Exceeded maximum tool call iterations (0)` as soon as triage tries to delegate, so order questions error out. A greeting needs no tool call, so it still gets a reply. `orderAgent` works alone because its own `maxTurns` is 4.

I did not run the app end to end; that needs a Gemini API key and a live model call. The type-check passes. `package.json` is unchanged.
